title: Match dossier
brief: The pre-match dossier for the tie of the Round of 16 at World Cup 2026: Portugal v Spain, Monday 6 July at Dallas Stadium, Arlington — the Iberian derby and a rematch of the 2025 Nations League final. Built on real, cited data as of 3 July 2026: both teams' road to this stage (group results + Round of 32), current form (last 5), model xG for/against, probable XIs and formations in SVG, tournament scorers (Ronaldo 3, Oyarzabal 4, Yamal), the head-to-head, THE key duel (Lamine Yamal v Nuno Mendes in the left channel), a set-piece note (Portugal's aerial menace v Spain's clean sheets), and Maradona's verdict in his voice — Spain 2-1 Portugal, extra time on the table.
da: 1980s matchday programme: warm newsprint cream, Anton condensed grotesk headlines, ink black + one hot Iberian red, halftone dot textures, ticket-stub and masthead motifs.
